clock.reason: mbtexcel 0.3.2 has no clock injection: NOW/TODAY read the host clock via @env.now(). The corpus `now` serial is ignored, so clock-tagged records are attributed to their own bucket instead of being counted as matches. Recorded actual values are the live host clock and therefore differ slightly between runs; bucket counts are stable.

iteration.reason: iter.max_iterations/max_change are stored with Workbook::set_calc_props, but calc_cell_typed does not consult CalcPropsOptions: evaluation is single-pass. Iteration cases are reported as observed, without any expectation of parity.
